dedupe_keys.name: geer rapid data acquisition for the investigation of post fire landslide hazards in the pacific northwest

description: GEER - Rapid data acquisition for the investigation of post-fire landslide hazards in the Pacific Northwest is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Adam Booth, Portland State University (pdx.edu). This project produced high-resolution point cloud data related to post-fire geologic hazards at sites affected by the 2020 Holiday Farm, 2020 Archie Creek, and 2017 Eagle Creek Fires in western Oregon. Data were acquired with terrestrial laser scanning and the structure-from-motion technique applied to Unmanned Aerial System optical imagery. Coverage: Finn Rock; Bogus Creek; Dodson, Oregon. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Post-fire, erosion, debris flow, rock fall, terrestrial lidar, Structure-from-motion. Published 2024-03-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
